notes.id: Fullday School: biaya awal tahun Rp6.400.000, IPP Rp420.000 (total awal Rp7.020.000); kuota 32 putra/32 putri. Vila Qur'an (boarding, tahfidz 30 juz): biaya awal tahun Rp12.100.000, IPP Rp1.250.000, uang saku & tabungan Rp250.000 (total Rp13.600.000). Cashback gelombang 1 (1 Sep–31 Des 2025): Rp500.000, alumni SDIT Nidaul Hikmah Rp1.500.000. IPP diasumsikan per bulan.
notes.en: Full-day School: start-of-year fee Rp6,400,000, IPP Rp420,000 (initial total Rp7,020,000); quota 32 boys/32 girls. Vila Qur'an (boarding, 30-juz memorisation): start-of-year Rp12,100,000, IPP Rp1,250,000, pocket money & savings Rp250,000 (total Rp13,600,000). Wave 1 cashback (1 Sep–31 Dec 2025): Rp500,000, SDIT Nidaul Hikmah alumni Rp1,500,000. IPP assumed to be monthly.

source.title: SPMB SMPIT Nidaul Hikmah Salatiga TA 2026/2027 (situs resmi)
